title: Capitol earmarks P100M in nat'l recovery aid for roads, bridge repairs
summary: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial government will channel its newly secured P100 million in national government recovery assistance toward repairing roads and bridges damaged by Typhoon Tino…

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial government will channel its newly secured P100 million in national government recovery assistance toward repairing roads and bridges damaged by Typhoon Tino and the September 2025 earthquake. Gov. Pamela Baricuatro said P15 million of the allocation would fund the rehabilitation of the Mulao-Dapdap Diversion Road, a 250-meter stretch […]...
